name: Road to De Other Side: the venom statues on the stairs breathe to the middle of the stairs for 15% of max health
contract: Issues #11375 and #10285: the venom statues along the stairs to the Chimeric Embryo (162975, placed in pairs facing each other about 17 to 21 yd apart) hit nobody in the middle of the stairs, and only for about 130 per tick at level 60. On Ascension they dealt about a third of a player's health. Expected (project owner decision, checked in game): the traps sit in the statue mouths, the wall check looks from 5.5 yd in front of the mouth so the statue itself does not block it, the breath reaches 11 yd ahead of the mouth, which covers the middle of every stair flight and overlaps the facing statue's breath there, 3 yd to either side, and each 0.5 s tick takes 15% of the target's maximum health; the fel flame visual stays, the breath keeps ticking for 3 s after the last flame is spat, so one breath lands nine ticks (project owner decision, checked in game: six ticks were too few), and each statue up the flight starts 1 s after the previous one has finished.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the statues are spawned
p stands in the middle of the first stair flight, 9 yd in front of statue 9370601
SETUP: p is in Road to De Other Side
within one breathing cycle the breath reaches the middle of the stairs and a tick takes 15% of max health
p steps 4.5 yd aside until the breath that hit p is surely over
enough health for the counted breath
a breath lasts at most 4.5 s and the statue's next one starts at least 11.5 s after the last
p returns to the middle of the stairs while that statue is quiet
the next breath of that statue starts
refill: the first ticks of the breath
refill: nine ticks of 15% would kill
the rest of the breath and a little more
DISCRIMINATING: the whole breath lands nine ticks (six before)
p steps 4.5 yd aside, out of the breath
beside the breath no tick lands (other damage nearby stays far below 15%)
